cond_0240.intro: The Senior Scientist- Analytical Chemistry works independently across all aspects of analytical methods, including method development, optimization, troubleshooting, qualification, and validation in areas related to some or all of the following: LC (SEC, RP, IEX, HIC etc.), mass spectroscopy, capillary electrophoresis, GC, and other small molecules and/or large molecules characterization methods. A regular part of this role involves staying in contact with cross-functional teams and communicating scientific findings clearly to colleagues and external partners.
cond_0240.responsibilities: Develop and execute — independently and collaboratively — all aspects of analytical methods to support the Bio-conjugation team, process development, product development, QC, in-process monitoring, stability studies, and drug substance. Work on analytical method development, optimization, troubleshooting, qualification, and validation in areas related to some or all of the following: LC (SEC, RP, IEX, HIC etc.), mass spectroscopy, capillary electrophoresis, GC, and other small molecules and/or large molecules characterization methods. Author analytical test methods, protocols, reports, and other documents. Act as an intellectual resource in area of expertise by supporting assay troubleshooting, investigations, and improving analytical methods. Contribute actively to improving processes and procedures. Lead and actively participate in project teams, speaking up to initiate discussions and bring people together to resolve issues. Review and interpret complex data and perform statistical analyses using appropriate software. Communicate scientific data and concepts effectively through presentations, protocols, test methods, and reports, both internally and externally — including walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions. Maintain a culture of safety and ensure safe work practices within the AMD lab. Adhere to EHS and quality standards set by regulations and company policies, procedures, and mission. Communicate regularly with supervisors, colleagues, clients, and vendors. Participate actively in scientific discussions; stay abreast of current literature in scientific areas; perform duties as required.
cond_0240.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. Or Masters in Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related area.
2–4 Years of experience in analytical method development and problem solving in the pharmaceutical industry.
Practical, hands-on experience with analytical instruments and method development using LC (SEC, RP, IEX, HIC etc.), mass spectroscopy, capillary electrophoresis, GC, and other small molecules and/or large molecules characterization methods.
Ability to handle complex data interpretation software and perform statistical analyses.
Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
Ability to be both an individual contributor and a collaborative team member.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to learn and work proactively.
Able to communicate scientific data effectively through presentations, protocols, test methods, and reports, both internally and externally — including initiating contact with supervisors and colleagues to clarify findings and resolve issues.
Adherence to company EHS and quality standards, regulations, and company policies, procedures, and mission.
Knowledge of cGMPs, particularly with respect to analytical method transfer.
Preferred Requirements
GMP experience.

Works on analytical method development, optimization, troubleshooting, qualification, and validation in areas related to some or all the following: LC (SEC, RP, IEX, HIC etc.), mass spectroscopy, capillary electrophoresis, GC, and other small molecules and/or large molecules characterization methods. Author analytical test methods, protocols, reports, and other documents. Act as an intellectual resource in area of expertise by supporting assay troubleshooting, investigations, and improving analytical methods. Contribute to improving processes and procedures. Lead and actively participate in project teams. Review and interpret complex data and perform statistical analyses using appropriate software. Communicate scientific data and concepts effectively through presentations, protocols, test methods, and reports internally and externally. Maintain a culture of safety and ensure safe work practices within the AMD lab. Adheres to EHS and quality standards set by regulations and company policies, procedures, and mission. Communicates effectively with supervisors, colleagues, clients, and vendors. Participates in scientific discussions; stays abreast of current literatures in scientific areas; Performs duties as required.
cond_0399.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. Or Master's in Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 2–4 years of experience in analytical method development and problem solving in the pharmaceutical industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Hands-on experience with analytical instruments and method development using instruments such as LC (SEC, RP, IEX, HIC etc.), mass spectroscopy, capillary electrophoresis, GC, and other small molecules and/or large molecules characterization methods.
Familiarity with complex data interpretation software and statistical analyses.
Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
Ability to communicate scientific data effectively through presentations, protocols, test methods, and reports internally and externally.
Willingness to learn and work proactively.
Ability to work as an individual contributor and as a collaborative team member.
Openness to applying critical thinking and problem-solving approaches.
Commitment to safety and adherence to EHS and quality standards, regulations, and company policies, procedures, and mission.
Ability to communicate effectively with supervisors and colleagues.

GMP experience.
